artworks.title: Tánger (Seated Arabs)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of cloaked figures in a shadowy archway. The scene is depicted in a monochrome etching style, showcasing a group of cloaked figures who appear to be huddled together on the ground. The setting is slightly dilapidated with a large archway in the background casting shadows across the figures. The texture of the drawing is rich with intricate lines creating a play of light and shadow. Details in the etching suggest a rough and worn surface on the walls and floor. The composition is dense with textures, bringing emphasis to the robes and the surrounding architecture.

artworks.title: La République Française
artworks.artist: Monogrammist G.H. after Pierre Paul Prud'hon
artworks.description: The image depicts a figure standing upright. The individual holds a staff with a sculpted hand at the top in the left hand and a small pyramid with the word "EGALITÉ" inscribed on it in the right hand. The figure has classical facial features with a prominent nose, short curly hair bound with a headband, and a focused expression. They wear a short, draped tunic cinched at the waist with a belt, sandals with straps, and their ankles are chained to a rectangular wooden platform. The background is a plain surface.

artworks.title: Costume de Paquita dans la Reine d'Espagne
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated in a relaxed position. She is shown from head to toe, with her left arm resting on an armrest and her right hand clutching her skirt. Her head is slightly tilted to the left. She has delicate features, full lips, and styled hair with a decorative headpiece or flowers. She wears an elaborate dress with a large structured bodice, intricate patterns, puffed sleeves, and cascading layers with tassel-like embellishments. A thin, transparent shawl or veil is draped over her shoulders. The background is minimally sketched, and she is positioned against an ornate surface.

artworks.title: Landscape with Sheep
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with rolling hills, a sky filled with clouds, and distant cliffs. The painting features trees, foliage, rocky outcrops, and sheep grazing on grass. The color scheme is warm and aged, dominated by sepia tones. Brushstrokes are detailed, creating texture on the trees and other elements in the scene.

artworks.title: Puits du Chateau de Nantes, Bretagne
artworks.description: The image shows a well with intricate ironwork at the center, placed on a circular stone base. Nearby, there is a grand building with ornate windows and detailed architectural features. In the distance, a smaller building with a tiled roof can be seen, with several individuals engaging in different activities. The sky is partially visible beyond the rooftops. The artwork uses precise lines to create a detailed texture, typical of a lithograph. The color palette is monochrome, with varying shades of gray and black. Shadows are utilized to add depth and volume to the scene.

artworks.title: Man and Woman Descending Staircase
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate, gothic-style interior with large windows and a grand staircase. The image shows a spacious hall with a vaulted ceiling supported by slender columns, adorned with intricate patterns and decorative elements. The staircase ascends in a gently curving manner, flanked by elegantly carved bannisters, leading up to a landing that is bathed in light streaming through tall, arched windows. The flooring is composed of large stone tiles, reflecting patches of light and shadow.

artworks.title: Fontaine de Jardin Borghese
artworks.description: The image shows a garden with a fountain as the central point. Lush trees cover the horizon creating a dense backdrop. A path to the left of the fountain leads deeper into the scene where a couple walks. Delicate brushstrokes give texture to the trees and foliage around the fountain. The color palette is primarily monochromatic with shades of gray. In the distance, trees of varying heights form curved shapes against the sky. Water arcs gracefully from the sculptural fountain. Figures dressed in period attire add historical charm to the scene.

artworks.title: Rustics Picnicking in Ruins
artworks.description: The image shows a rocky scene with ruins, figures, and a sloping hillside. The horizon is high in the composition, with sparse vegetation like bushes and trees. The brushstrokes are fine and intricate, creating texture and detail. The color palette is monochrome, with shades of gray, black, and white. In the foreground are the remains of a stone structure and two figures, with the terrain climbing upward with steps and stonework. In the distance, the landscape continues to rise, dotted with more remnants of ancient constructions.

artworks.title: Christ on the Mount of Olives
artworks.artist: Pieter de Bailliu after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in a natural setting. The figure on the left likely represents an angel, partially visible from the waist up, with one hand raised holding a cup and the other hand pointing towards the man. The figure has wings and flowing garments. The second figure, on the right, is sitting or kneeling on a rocky surface. This figure has long hair and a beard, facing the angel. He wears long, flowing robes and has his right hand placed on his chest, while his left hand rests on his knee. In the background, there is a large tree, clouds with rays of light, an evening sky, and faint outlines of buildings or structures in the distance.

artworks.title: Shepherd and Flock under an Ancient Tree
artworks.description: The image features a pastoral scene seen from an eye-level perspective. A flock of sheep is walking on a cobblestone path, with a large tree dominating the right side of the composition. The tree's trunk extends upwards and its branches spread across the upper part of the image. The artwork uses detailed etching to depict the tree bark, leaves, and the sheep's wooly texture. The horizon is in the middle distance, with trees and faint structures suggesting a rural landscape. The background shows more trees and delicate lines, creating a serene natural environment. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades created by the etching pattern to convey depth and texture, giving the image a timeless quality.

artworks.title: The Entrance of the French into Milan, 15 May 1796
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing a procession with mounted horsemen and musicians. The scene portrays several finely dressed individuals on horseback alongside a group of musicians playing instruments like flutes and drums. The musicians wear robes and turbans. In the background, there are onlookers or participants present, adding depth and a festive atmosphere to the composition. The style of the drawing suggests a historical or ceremonial event highlighted by attention to detail and movement in the figures and animals.

artworks.title: Five Vignettes
artworks.description: The image shows a collection of sketches featuring various scenes and characters. In the upper left corner, there is a full-body profile of a man walking with a large backpack on his shoulders, wearing a hat with a feather and holding a cane-like stick. He is dressed in a jacket, pants tucked into boots. To the right are two figures – an older man with a large hat and a younger boy. The older man is seated on a stone wearing loose clothing and boots, with his arm resting on a cane. The boy stands in front of him, holding something in his hand and wearing a hat and cloak. At the bottom left, there is a close-up of a man's face and shoulders with a downturned gaze, tousled hair, and dressed in a collared garment. In the bottom right, there is a back-view portrait of a kneeling figure in a hooded cloak, with a peaceful rural scene in the background featuring a small house surrounded by trees. The drawings are monochromatic with detailed shading.

artworks.title: Eight Vignettes
artworks.description: The image displays a series of sketches featuring various individuals, mostly soldiers. One sketch shows a figure riding a horse in a landscape with other figures, potentially in a military setting. Below, another figure stands in a uniform. Next to them, a person with facial hair is portrayed in a half-profile view. Another sketch shows a bust of a man in profile. In another sketch, a soldier is depicted against a pyramid backdrop. Below, a soldier in a similar uniform holds a rifle. On the left, an elderly woman with a child stands in front of a thatched house. The sketches have different backgrounds, adding depth to the overall collection.

artworks.title: Five Vignettes
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various scenes depicting domestic life and interactions. The drawing features five distinct scenes. The top left scene shows two individuals in historical costumes engaged in conversation, holding a large firearm and a walking stick. The top right portrays a woman in a striped dress with a jug on her head gesturing towards a seated figure leaning against a wall. Below, three more vignettes depict an individual seated at a desk, another sewing with concentration, and a couple dancing in formal attire. The piece is rendered in a detailed and realistic style, with intricate textures and shading.

artworks.title: Three Vignettes
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several scenes featuring figures and a horse. The drawing includes three main vignettes: a figure in a long coat and hat beside a stone wall, a horseman in detailed uniform on a horse, and two figures, one adult and one child, engaged in an activity involving a book or paper. The scene is monochromatic with delicate shading. The signature 'H. Bellange. 1831.' is present.

artworks.title: "Les Scélérats!..."
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with multiple figures. In the center, a person is reclining with a gun nearby. Another figure is standing next to them, gesturing dramatically. Two other figures are in the background, one raising a weapon and the other moving to the left. The setting includes stone surfaces and fog or smoke in the background.

artworks.title: L'Allocution, 20 juillet, 1830
artworks.description: This drawing depicts a historical scene of armed individuals in a barricaded street during a period of unrest. A central figure addresses others as debris litters the street. Several individuals are armed with muskets and pistols, with one holding a flag. The architecture and attire suggest a 19th-century setting. In the background, a rider on horseback and figures in combat are enveloped in smoke.

artworks.title: Cuirassiers Charging
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a cavalry battle scene. It features cavalry soldiers on horseback engaged in combat, showing a soldier on a dark horse holding a sword and appearing to charge. Additional soldiers, horses, a cannon, and disrupted ground are visible in the background, conveying a sense of a chaotic battlefield. The drawing emphasizes movement and action through detailed depictions of the horses and uniforms.

artworks.title: Infantryman
artworks.artist: Louis d' Orléans, Duc de Nemours
artworks.description: The image depicts a soldier in side profile. The soldier has a moustache and wears a tall shako hat with a plume. He is in a military uniform with a double-breasted jacket, trousers, and shoes. The uniform includes epaulettes and a bandolier. The soldier carries a backpack, a blanket, and a rifle. The background shows a landscape with shrubs, a building with arched windows, and a distant structure or town on the horizon.

artworks.title: Carabinier
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mounted figure in a military uniform. It depicts a horseman wearing elaborate armor, complete with a large, plumed helmet, seated atop a robust horse. The horse is standing still. In the background, there are additional figures on horseback and a crowd gathered. The setting appears to be outdoors, with sparse trees and a building visible. The artwork highlights details in the armor and the musculature of the horse, capturing the discipline and grandeur of a cavalry regiment.

artworks.title: Croisés en Campagne
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an army in motion. The scene shows a group of armored soldiers on horseback advancing across a barren landscape. The composition is dense with figures carrying lances and shields, wearing elaborate helmets and armor typical of medieval times. In the background, more soldiers are visible, fading into the horizon. The ground is uneven, with a hint of vegetation in the distance, implying an outdoor campaign. The monochrome shading creates contrast and depth, adding a dramatic and dynamic quality to the scene.

artworks.title: Les Munitionaires du 28 Juillet
artworks.description: This image features a crowd of people, predominantly men, in various positions in a street scene that suggests a conflict or uprising. In the center is a man standing confidently with a rifle in his right hand, wearing a military-style uniform with a tall hat and gesturing with his left hand. Nearby are a few children in period clothing, one reaching out towards the man. Other men in the scene wear different hats, and there is movement with some crouching or running. In the background are more people, a haze of smoke or dust, and faint outlines of buildings. The image is monochrome and appears to be engraved.

artworks.title: La Reconciliation
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures gathered around a table outdoors. The scene depicts four figures interacting with one another. The figures are dressed in military or ceremonial uniforms. The composition includes a wooden structure with a bench and table, set against a backdrop of a stone building with the words "BONNE EAU DE VIE" inscribed on it. One figure is leaning against the wall with their arm around another figure while holding a glass. The foreground and background contain details like foliage and distant architecture. The title of the drawing is "La Réconciliation." The artist has used lines and shading to create detail and texture in the drawing.

artworks.title: Soldier's Family Encamped
artworks.medium: lithograph on brown wove paper, heightened with white gouache
artworks.description: Three individuals are positioned closely together in an outdoor setting dominated by trees and rocks. One individual is seated on the ground, wearing a cloak and hood. Beside them, another individual is adjusting the cloak of a child standing in front. Nearby, a horse is tied to a stone structure. The background features a dense forest with tree trunks and branches, while the ground is uneven with grass and rough textures.
